description: This file declares utility functions for extracting images and archive contents, as well as extracting archives to memory, within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It includes function signatures with parameters related to archive handling, such as file paths, target directories, and options for keeping archives.

methods.name: ExtractImages
methods.description: Extracts multiple images from an archive to a target directory, optionally keeping the archive.

methods.name: ExtractImage
methods.description: Extracts a single image from an archive to a target directory, with an option to keep the archive.

methods.name: ExtractArchiveContents
methods.description: Retrieves contents of an archive into a vector of strings.

methods.name: ExtractArchiveToMemory
methods.description: Extracts an entire archive to memory as a string.

methods.name: ArchiveContents
methods.description: Returns a list of contents within the specified archive.
